**Finding submitted: deviation (AUDIT), confidence 0.82**

**What I found.** The only audit right binding us is Article II § IV(b) (p0073), with the cost-allocation sentence sitting at p0064 (displaced just after the fee table).

**Assessment against the playbook:**

| Term | Document | Playbook |
|---|---|---|
| Cost | Licensor bears unless >5% discrepancy | ✅ Preferred |
| Auditor | Independent CPA/Audit Professional, mutual agreement | ✅ Preferred |
| Scope | "appropriate accounting records" only | ✅ No system access |
| Notice | Audit permitted within 30 days of written request | ✅ Functions as adequate notice |
| **Frequency** | **None — unlimited** | ❌ Fails preferred *and* fallback |

The absence of any frequency cap is the material failure: Licensor could demand audits repeatedly, which approaches the walk-away position on unlimited audits. Everything else already meets or beats the fallback, so I left it alone rather than over-redlining a clause that is largely favourable to us.

**Redline (validated ok:true)** — two minimal insertions into p0073: auditor "bound by written obligations of confidentiality," and audits "no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, during Licensee's normal business hours, and without access to Licensee's systems or networks." The 5% cost provision at p0064 is untouched.
